title: <anchor-dir>/declared-effects.jsonl (one record per line)
description: Generated by scripts/evidence-v0.3-compose.mjs; do not edit by hand. One closed shape per record version, chosen by `discriminator` on `schema`. Every `effect` discriminates on `kind` (effects/<kind>.schema.json); schema 3 discriminates on `kind_of_entry` (commissaire/<kind>.schema.json). The line validator `declaredEffectViolations` (effects.js) enforces what the subset cannot.

effect-decision-request.title: declared-effects.jsonl schema-3 record, kind_of_entry effect-decision-request
effect-decision-request.description: A producer's request for a decision (commissaire.ts cmdRequestDecision). payload.effect is the caller's raw descriptor.

effect.description: Named open node: the caller's raw effect descriptor, chained as given. evaluateDecisionRequest judges it and denies a malformed one invalid-effect-descriptor.

declared_ref.description: No reader interprets it; the governor compares it by equality.

effect-decision-verdict.title: declared-effects.jsonl schema-3 record, kind_of_entry effect-decision-verdict
effect-decision-verdict.description: Commissaire's signed verdict on a request (commissaire.ts cmdRequestDecision, governor.ts authorize). level_policy and the pure fields are present when a level was supplied.

effect.description: Named open node: the caller's raw effect descriptor, chained as given. evaluateDecisionRequest judges it and denies a malformed one invalid-effect-descriptor.

reconcile.title: declared-effects.jsonl schema-3 record, kind_of_entry reconcile
reconcile.description: Reserved for the producer by KIND_AUTHOR, with no writer in code (cmdReconcile prints and never appends). The strictest shape: no effect and no payload.

conformed_to_contract.title: declared-effects.jsonl schema-3 record, kind_of_entry conformed_to_contract
conformed_to_contract.description: Commissaire's terminal conclusion (commissaire.ts cmdTerminalVerdict, governor.ts conclude).

accepted_under_contract.title: declared-effects.jsonl schema-3 record, kind_of_entry accepted_under_contract
accepted_under_contract.description: The frozen pre-FAFF-1221 name of conformed_to_contract. Signed records carrying it can never be renamed; conclusionKindOf reads both.
